title: Daq hero
description: A window-tall, transparent hero: a two-line uppercase headline at 8vw (a hairline-thin first line over a heavy payoff word), a tracked monospace intro and a square outlined button, left-aligned and vertically centred. On load the lines rise into place and the intro slides in from the left; as you scroll away the whole block fades out and drifts down 128px.
notes: transparent: made to sit over daq-backdrop (place the backdrop first on the page); without it, pass a background in className
100svh tall, as on the original; the fixed daq-header overlays its top
the scroll fade is CSS scroll-driven (no JavaScript); older browsers show the hero still
